profile.org_note: Seven operating divisions (West, Northwest, Central, Midwest, Florida, Southeast, Mid-Atlantic) roll into five reportable segments (Midwest into Central, Mid-Atlantic into Southeast); below them, market-level leaders carry Division President or Regional President titles, but the company publishes no regional roster. Land deals are sourced and underwritten by market VP-level land acquisition and development staff and approved centrally by the Acquisitions Committee: CEO Eric Lipar, CFO/Treasurer Charles Merdian and EVP of Acquisitions Jack Lipar; capital-markets contact is Joshua Fattor (EVP Finance and Capital Markets).
profile.summary: Entry-level builder (LGI Homes and move-up Terrata Homes brands) in 36 markets across 21 states, headquartered in The Woodlands, TX; 151 active communities at 30 Sep 2026. Unusually land-heavy for a public builder: 58,400 owned and controlled lots at 30 Sep 2026, of which 50,270 (86%) are owned and only 8,130 controlled, and it self-develops most of its lots. Land decisions are centralised in a three-person corporate Acquisitions Committee.
